final_message: Parsed the log file by reading each entry and filtering only ERROR and CRITICAL levels (case insensitive). Converted timestamps to UTC format, extracted service, level, message, and last traceback line as exception or null. Calculated repeat_count including repeated message lines. Aggregated counts by service. Saved the structured data to workspace/errors.json following the Acme log-triage conventions.

checks.name: rule_service_names
checks.detail: RULE: service names in the output are lower-case with '-' replaced by '_' (payment-service -> payment_service).

checks.name: rule_sorted_errors
checks.detail: RULE: `errors` is sorted by service, then by timestamp_utc, ascending.

checks.name: rule_schema_header
